text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wants to change...
Not stay the useless me I am now, but...
become someone who can make everyone happier...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
S-So... please take good care
of Rice, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
S-So... please take good care
of Rice, Big Sister.

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
